details: Ultragoal initialized with 6 micro-goals for SuperSwingTimer deep audit and enhancement.

evidence: SuperSwingTimer.toc updated to v0.2.2, SuperSwingTimer.lua DB migration v62 added with DB_CURRENT_VERSION=62, CHANGELOG.md and README.md updated.

Enlarged default hunter cast bar height to 15px in SuperSwingTimer_Constants.lua, SuperSwingTimer_UI.lua, and SuperSwingTimer_Config.lua, matching standard swing bar height.

Organized quick controls into per-class sections for all 6 classes; added Power/Resource Bar toggles and color pickers; wired power bar into ShowBarPreview, HideBarPreview, and AnimateTestBars in SuperSwingTimer_Config.lua.

Updated SuperSwingTimer_Tests.lua with DefaultFont_Resolves, PlayerPowerBar_Structure, and CreateGlowBorder_Safe; verified luacheck . produces 0 warnings and 0 errors across all 11 Lua files; resolved both CurseForge bugs (font escape and SetPoint Height error); re-anchored all debuff bar icons outside left with clear margin and zero overlap.
